column11: JUDGEMENT. Roche names no filing date: its HY 2026 pipeline (status 23 July 2026) lists RG6149 astegolimab in COPD at Phase III and leaves it off the expected regulatory submissions chart, and on 21 July 2025 it said it would discuss ALIENTO and ARNASA with regulators. The book's Phase 3 rule, the earliest Phase 3 primary completion plus two, gives ARNASA's 2025-06-24 plus two, 2027, which cannot hold: nothing was filed by September 2026, and a filing now under a standard twelve-month review would make 2028 the first full year at best. The one Phase 3 still open is the long-term safety extension NCT05878769 (active, not recruiting, primary completion 2027-06-30, ClinicalTrials.gov API read 2026-09-28). A filing on the two 52-week studies with that safety set gives 2027 plus two, 2029
column12: the case for later: if the FDA asks for another 52-week exacerbation study, as one ALIENTO and ARNASA investigator said it might (touchRESPIRATORY, 22 May 2026), the first full year moves into the 2030s
